title: Design System: DOT ANNE HOME LODGE

display.purpose: The hero headline inside the title block only, max 16ch.

headline.purpose: Section h2s in Brand Forest (Light Paper on green).

title.purpose: Legend h3s at step-2, room name at step-3, big cell values.

lede.purpose: Section intros in Warm Ink, 40 to 58ch.

label.purpose: Condensed caps lettering for data cells, definition terms, footer column heads and map labels. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: pinned
shadows.purpose: Photo plates and the booking slip, pinned to the sheet.

shadows.name: plate-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero title block over the photograph; dropped on phones.

shadows.name: header-scrolled
shadows.purpose: Fixed header once the page scrolls.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus-visible ring in Hairline Gold.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one curve: every transition, reveal and draw.

motion.name: plate-reveal
motion.purpose: Photo plates and blocks wipe in once on scroll.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 over 2.6s, 0.3s delay; controls scale in at 0.3s / 1s / 1.8s / 2.6s
motion.purpose: Signature: the gold route draws from Kpone Barrier to No. 473.

motion.name: ink-in
motion.value: opacity 0, translateY(10px), blur(3px) to rest over 0.9s, staggered 0.35s to 0.75s
motion.purpose: Hero title block contents after the block plates up.

motion.name: underline-draw
motion.value: scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) over 0.4s from left

narrative.overview:
The site is the plan sheet for one plot, No. 473 Golf Estate. Ivory drafting paper is the ground; forest green is the land and fills the big fields (the hero title block, the location sheet, the booking preview, the footer); muted gold is reserved for survey hairlines, the route line, plot markers and the primary action; charcoal is the ink. Everything is drawn with hairline rules, registration ticks and labelled cells, as a surveyor would letter a sheet, not as a hotel brochure would decorate a page.

Density is calm and generous: one strict 12-column grid, large section breathing room, content arranged as plan legends, spec tables and schedules rather than cards. Real photographs of the lodge are pinned to the sheet as plates, with corner ticks and a caption strip. Motion is plan ink: lines draw with stroke-dashoffset, plates wipe in with clip-path, all on one ease-out-expo curve, once, and every piece of content is visible with motion off.
keyCharacteristics: Four inks only: forest green, ivory, gold, charcoal.
Hairline rules (1px gold at partial strength) do the structural work that borders, cards and shadows do elsewhere.
Labelled cells in condensed caps carry data (Plot, Estate, Plus Code, Front desk).
Corner registration ticks frame title blocks and photo plates.
Gloock serif headlines in forest green; Archivo variable sans for everything else.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Green, ivory, gold, charcoal. No fifth hue enters the system; the only exceptions are functional signals (the live "open" dot and form-error red) and they never decorate.

rules.name: The Gold Is Survey Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only as hairlines, the route, plot markers, labels on green, and the one primary button. Never a gold background panel, never gold body text on ivory below gold-700.

rules.name: The Land Is Green Rule
rules.body: Large fields of colour are forest green and they are architectural (title block, location sheet, slip preview, footer). Ivory is paper; green is land; nothing else gets a field.

rules.name: The Lettered Cell Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps labels name a value that sits directly beside or beneath them (a cell, a definition term, a map feature). They are never placed above a section heading as decoration.

rules.name: The One Weight Serif Rule
rules.body: Gloock is set at 400 only. Emphasis comes from size and the green ink, not weight.

rules.name: The Pinned Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, green-tinted and short; they say "pinned to the sheet", never "floating card". Ruled lists and sections carry no shadow.

rules.name: The Survey Frame Rule
rules.body: A framed object gets the 10px inset hairline and/or corner ticks, not a thicker border or a rounded card.

dos: Do keep to the four inks; use gold-700 when gold must be small text on ivory, gold-300 when it letters green.
Do separate content with hairline rules (`--rule` for rows, `--rule-strong` for the top of a ruled list) instead of boxes.
Do letter data with condensed caps labels (0.75rem, 600, 0.12em, `wdth` 72) placed beside or above their value.
Do frame real photographs as plates with corner ticks and a caption strip.
Do animate with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` once, as ink drawing or clip-path reveals, and leave everything visible under reduced motion.
Do keep corners at 2px and hit targets at 44px or more.
donts: Don't fill any panel or background with gold; gold fills belong to the primary button and the home plot marker only.
Don't set a centred headline directly over a full-bleed photo; headlines sit in a green title block or on the paper.
Don't lay out features as rows of equal cards; use ruled legends, spec tables and schedules.
Don't put condensed caps labels above section headings as kickers or eyebrows.
Don't use stock imagery presented as the lodge, or round cards, pill buttons and heavy floating shadows.
Don't bold Gloock; it is set at 400.
